title: Ginsenoside Rg3 inhibits melanoma progression by inducing ferroptosis via the p53/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway.
authors: Ma, Anting; Zhu, Shunyao; Yao, Xiaowen; Chen, Yusang; Yao, Jingjing; Shen, Mengdan; Shi, Senlin; Han, Xi; Zhang, Ting
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rg3通过p53/SLC7A11/GPX4通路诱导黑色素瘤铁死亡，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Melanoma represents an aggressive cutaneous malignancy with limited treatment options. Ginsenoside Rg3, an active component extracted from the roots of Panax ginseng, has been extensively demonstrated to possess significant anti-tumor efficacy, showing promising application potential in the treatment of various malignancies. However, the role of Rg3 in melanoma treatment and its related mechanisms have not been reported in detail. Thus, exploring and elucidating reliable molecular mechanisms is critical. OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic efficacy of ginsenoside Rg3 in melanoma and its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: This research investigated the mechanism of melanoma pathogenesis using a clinical cohort database and established a corresponding disease model. By integrating transcriptomic and metabolomic approaches, we systematically explored the intrinsic molecular mechanisms by which Rg3 regulated ferroptosis in melanoma. Then, immunohistochemistry (IHC), reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), western blotting (WB), molecular docking (MD), and molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) were used for validation. RESULTS: The database analysis revealed that melanoma was associated with the ferroptosis pathway. In vitro experiments showed that Rg3 inhibited the proliferation of melanoma cells. The functional annotation and enrichment analysis of differentially expressed genes and metabolites based on animal transcriptome and metabolome experiments showed that Rg3 exerted therapeutic effects by regulating the glutathione metabolism pathway and ferroptosis pathway. The detection based on the reagent kit revealed significant changes in ferroptosis-related biomarkers. IHC, RT-qPCR, and WB analyses confirmed the expression patterns of ferroptosis-associated mRNAs and proteins. MD and MDS confirmed stable binding between Rg3 and p53, SLC7A11, GPX4, and FTH1 proteins. CONCLUSION: Rg3 induced melanoma ferroptosis via the p53/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway, offering therapeutic potential for melanoma.
abstract_zh: 引言：黑色素瘤是一种侵袭性皮肤恶性肿瘤，治疗选择有限。人参皂苷Rg3是从人参根部提取的活性成分，已被广泛证明具有显著的抗肿瘤功效，在多种恶性肿瘤的治疗中显示出广阔的应用前景。然而，Rg3在黑色素瘤治疗中的作用及其相关机制尚未被详细报道。因此，探索并阐明可靠的分子机制至关重要。目的：本研究旨在探讨人参皂苷Rg3在黑色素瘤中的治疗效果及其潜在机制。方法：本研究利用临床队列数据库调查了黑色素瘤发病机制，并建立了相应的疾病模型。通过整合转录组学和代谢组学方法，我们系统探索了Rg3调控黑色素瘤铁死亡 (ferroptosis) 的内在分子机制。随后，使用免疫组织化学 (immunohistochemistry, IHC)、逆转录定量聚合酶链反应 (reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction, RT-qPCR)、蛋白质印迹 (western blotting, WB)、分子对接 (molecular docking, MD) 和分子动力学模拟 (molecular dynamics simulation, MDS) 进行验证。结果：数据库分析显示，黑色素瘤与铁死亡通路相关。体外实验表明，Rg3抑制了黑色素瘤细胞的增殖。基于动物转录组和代谢组实验的差异表达基因和代谢物的功能注释及富集分析显示，Rg3通过调控谷胱甘肽代谢通路和铁死亡通路发挥治疗作用。基于试剂盒的检测显示，铁死亡相关生物标志物发生显著变化。IHC、RT-qPCR和WB分析确认了铁死亡相关mRNA和蛋白的表达模式。MD和MDS确认了Rg3与p53、SLC7A11、GPX4和FTH1蛋白之间的稳定结合。结论：Rg3通过p53/SLC7A11/GPX4通路诱导黑色素瘤铁死亡，为黑色素瘤治疗提供了潜在可能性。
